<panel>
	<name>DLabel</name>
	<parent>Label</parent>
	<preview>DLabel_small.png</preview>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<file line="">lua/vgui/dlabel.lua</file>
	<description>
		A standard Derma text label. A lot of this panels functionality is a base for button elements, such as <page>DButton</page>
	</description>
</panel>

<example>
	<description>Creates a DLabel.</description>
	<code>
local Panel = vgui.Create( "DFrame" )
Panel:SetSize( 200, 200 )
Panel:Center()
Panel:MakePopup()

local DLabel = vgui.Create( "DLabel", Panel )
DLabel:SetPos( 40, 40 )
DLabel:SetText( "Hello, world!" )
	</code>
	<output><image src="DLabel.png"/></output>
</example>
